title: grothlab/glseq pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: The sample identifier cannot contain spaces

biological_replicate.errorMessage: The biological replicate must be provided and cannot contain spaces. If you do not have biological replicates you can set the replicate value to the same number or string for all of your samples.

technical_replicate.errorMessage: Technical replicate must be provided and cannot contain spaces. If you do not have technical replicates you can set the replicate value to the same number or string for all of your samples.

input_control.errorMessage: The input control column cannot contain spaces

input_control_biological_replicate.errorMessage: Input control biological replicate number must be an integer greater than or equal to 1

exp_type.errorMessage: Sequencing experiment type must be provided and be one of 'ChIP-seq', 'ChOR-seq', 'SCAR-seq', 'ChIP-exo', 'ATAC-seq' or 'OK-seq'

okseq_part_file.errorMessage: GZIP-compressed FastQ file for OK-seq RFD/partition file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.txt.gz' or '.tsv.gz'

fastq_1.errorMessage: GZIP-compressed FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: GZIP-compressed FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_umi.errorMessage: GZIP-compressed FastQ file for UMI reads cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'
